subject: Visibility Suite: retention commitments, tracing configuration & credits
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@brightleafhealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightleafhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify pricing on Visibility add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the tracing UI and the advanced dashboards. Procurement asked me to get a clearer picture of how the add-ons are priced before we move to a legal review. Two quick areas where we need concrete numbers and examples:

- Retention: you quoted "flexible retention tiers" in the deck. Can you provide 30/90/365-day unit pricing and an example monthly bill for our expected telemetry volumes (we project ~0.8 TB ingest/day across services with 1.2 TB of compressed storage growth per month). Also note any minimums or rounding rules.
- Tracing: does tracing cost scale with spans ingested or is it licensed per service? How do sampling rate changes impact cost?
- Advanced dashboards: pricing per seat vs. per-organization? Any limits on number of dashboards or panels?

Separately, BrightLeaf Procurement would like to understand discounting for a 12-month committed spend (we expect to start with a 12-month commit and then evaluate renewal). Please attach an updated SOW or pricing workbook we can circulate to our finance team.

I'll attach our draft SOW for context. Can we get a written pricing example by EOD Wednesday? Procurement is trying to lock the vendor list by Friday.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Klein
Head of Engineering Programs
BrightLeaf Health

Attachment: SOW_draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Clarify pricing on Visibility add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I've put together a concise pricing view below and attached a one-page PDF with worked examples. High level summary first, then the examples.

High level (Visibility Suite add-ons):
- Retention (stored metric & trace data): billed as GB-month.
  * 30-day tier: $0.09 per GB-month
  * 90-day tier: $0.065 per GB-month
  * 365-day tier: $0.045 per GB-month
  Note: we only bill for final stored size after compression; we provide a monthly estimate and a cap mechanism for predictable billing.
- Tracing: base price is per-hosted-service license + per-GB span storage.
  * Service license: $150/service/month (covers unlimited ingested spans up to 10k TPS per service)
  * Span storage: $0.12 per GB-month (if you increase sampling, the span storage line grows proportionally; sampling reductions reduce this cost linearly)
- Advanced Dashboards: seat-based + panel bundle
  * Power seat: $75/seat/month (includes unlimited dashboard creation, alerting, 5 TB query quota)
  * View-only seat: $10/seat/month
  * Dashboard bundle (optional): $1,000/month for up to 200 custom panels and org-level templates

Discounting & committed spend examples (12 month initial term):
- Standard: list pricing above (no commit)
- 10% tier: requires $100k annual committed spend across Redwood products
- 15% tier: requires $250k annual committed spend or 18-month commit

Pilot concession: for customers starting with a 12-month commit we can provide a one-time credit equal to 2 months of Retention charges (applied in month 2) to offset initial indexing costs.

Worked example for your volumes (estimate assumptions: 0.8 TB/day ingest => ~24 TB/month raw; post-processing + compression => 6.5 TB stored):
- If you pick 90-day tier for all telemetry: 6.5 TB * 1024 GB/TB * $0.065 = ~$432.64/month (rounded)
- Tracing (assume 12 services live): 12 * $150 = $1,800/month + span storage (say 1 TB stored traces => 1024 GB * $0.12 = $122.88) => total tracing ~$1,922.88/month
- Dashboards (5 power seats + 20 view seats): (5 * $75) + (20 * $10) = $475/month

Total example (90-day): ~$2.8k/month before discounts/commit credits. With a 10% committed spend discount, this drops to ~$2.52k/month and we would apply the 2-month retention credit in month 2.

See attached PDF: visibility-pricing-v1.pdf for the same example laid out with sliding scales and a 12/24 month comparison.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, we can prepare a mutual action plan + SOW reflecting chosen retention tier and commit level.
2) If procurement needs a different commit threshold for 15% discount, share expected annual spend and I can run an approval for a counter-offer.
3) Marissa, copying you to propose a 30-day pilot checklist (instrumentation + dashboards).

Available for a quick call tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT or Thursday 14:00–16:00 PT.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@brightleafhealth.com>

Subject: RE: Clarify pricing on Visibility add-ons (retention / tracing / dashboards)

Aditya — thanks for the quick turnaround, that helps a lot. A few follow-ups / counterpoints from Procurement and Finance:

- The 2-month retention credit is helpful. Procurement is asking if that credit could be applied as an "initial index credit" that covers both retention ingestion and trace index costs (they prefer a single-line credit).
- For the discount bands: a 15% discount tied to an 18-month commit is acceptable but BrightLeaf typically signs 12-month terms. Would Redwood consider 15% for $200k ARR instead of an 18-month time box?
- SLA credits: we need an explicit SLO/SLA for trace query latency and retention availability for the 365-day tier. Can you include SLA language (downtime credits, measurement windows) in the SOW?

Finally, we'd prefer the pilot to include 3 power seats (not 5) for the evaluation and instrumentation assistance from your team. Procurement wants to know if the pilot can be zero-cost subject to signing the 12-month commitment before pilot end.

Can you run those three asks and get back with an updated SOW/pricing by Friday EOD?

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — looping in from CS to outline how the pilot can be structured and to confirm the technical points Aditya raised. Quick notes: 

- Single-line credit: we can consolidate the 2-month credit into an "initial index credit" that applies to the Visibility invoice and is applied against both retention and tracing index charges. We'll reflect that in the SOW.
- 15% discount for $200k ARR: I can approve a 15% discount at $200k committed ARR for the 12-month term, subject to legal/finance signoff. That mirrors some precedent we have with other health-tech customers.
- SLA language: draft SLA clauses will include retention availability (99.9% monthly for 365-day tier) and trace query P95 latency targets (e.g., <450ms for queries under 5s window), with crediting formula tied to minutes of unavailability. Legal will want to tune precise definitions but we'll include a workable draft.
- Pilot: we can run a zero-cost pilot that includes 3 power seats and up to 30 days of full-featured dashboard/tracing access if you sign the 12-month commitment by pilot day 20. We'll provide an instrumentation checklist and two 3-hour onboarding sessions.

Attached is a short pilot-checklist.xlsx with the instrumentation items and a proposed timeline.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Sarah / Procurement — thanks for the quick feedback. To summarize the agreed commercial path and next steps so legal/procurement have a tidy package to review: 

1) Discounts & commit: 15% off Visibility add-ons (retention, tracing storage, dashboard seats) for a $200k committed ARR on a 12-month term. Finance/legal review required but this is the approved commercial concession.

2) Initial index credit: 2 months equivalent credit consolidated into a single "Initial Index Credit" (applies to retention + trace indexing lines). Credit will be applied in month 2 of billing.

3) Pilot terms: zero-cost pilot for up to 30 days with 3 power seats if BrightLeaf signs the 12-month commitment by pilot day 20. Includes two onboarding sessions and instrumentation support (per pilot-checklist.xlsx).

4) SLA: SOW will include draft SLA language: 99.9% retention availability for 365-day tier + P95 trace query latency targets and the associated crediting formula. Legal can redline but we will ship a draft with the SOW.

5) Next doc: I've asked Legal to prepare the SOW + MSA with the negotiated commercial terms and will attach DocuSign when ready. Expect a first pass by Friday EOD. Please reply to confirm the $200k target and we'll lock it in on our side.

Thanks — I'll circulate the SOW once Legal finishes the redlines.
